The project was launched on Kickstarter.
The funding goal for the project was $14,122.
$857 was pledged towards the project.

fact_previews: www.prayerwalking.ca is a website that allows users to log their prayerwalking routes and see what part of their community has been prayed through.
As time passes, the logged prayerwalking routes on www.prayerwalking.ca get lighter, indicating how recently they have been prayed through.
If a community is sponsored, everyone can see the state of the prayer canopy over that community in real time.
The prayerwalking tool has received a great response since its launch in August.
The proposal includes developing a smartphone app to make the prayerwalking tool easier to use.

fact_previews: The app is expected to take about 3 months to develop and go through initial debugging.
After the initial debugging, another 3 months will be needed for more thorough debugging through actual trials.
An Android app will be available shortly after the iPhone app.
Pledging $50 or more will result in receiving a copy of the book 'Beginnings – growing in prayer through Genesis'.
Pledging $100 or more will result in receiving a signed copy of the book.
